text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Running along the inner rail is certainly the shortest distance.
However, taking corners at a sharp angle forces you to brake.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You're right, compared to Bakushin O,
I've slowed down considerably. I didn't even notice...
choice_data_list: That's why you take a line where you don't have to slow down as much.
That's why you take a line where you don't have to slow down as much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's the fastest possible route!
In my case, cornering is entirely by feel.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that said, longer distances are more draining.
It would be best for me to find my own optimal balance by feel as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll go run half a lap, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cornering—a technique whose countermeasures had been postponed.
Now that she has mastered running at top speed,
she has finally reached the point of tackling it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "When I had just moved up to the Classic Year, it was mostly about addressing my weaknesses."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, what we are currently pursuing
is cornering designed to achieve maximum speed.
How to blaze through 1,200 meters as fast as possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Once she masters cornering,
Light O-san's running style will be virtually complete.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how thrilling!
I wonder what kind of run Daitaku Helios
will show us in the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Niigata Local Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's so packed! That's a GⅠ for ya!
Getting to see a GⅠ in Niigata is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm back, Niigata Racecourse!
Brings back memories of the Ibis Summer Dash!
Light O was so amazing back then!"

text_block_list.name: Niigata Local Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Man, she was fast!
Calstone Light O is running today too, right?
Isn't 1st place pretty much in the bag for her~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's gotta be Believe!
She set a record win in the prep race.
Her running right now is flawless without a single opening."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Of course Calstone! That overwhelming wind pressure I felt here!
She's sure to blow past everyone again today!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, today is 1200m, so aptitude-wise, Believe might have the upper hand...? But when it comes to raw speed, Daitaku Helios feels like a contender too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because Niigata Racecourse doesn't normally host GⅠ races,
the crowd was engulfed in tremendous excitement.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps Calstone-san deserves some credit too? Her run in the Ibis Summer Dash was shocking, after all."
choice_data_list: I'd be so happy if that's true!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, why don't you go ahead
and tell Daitaku Helios too?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
It is so lively outside.
The cheers and vibrations are reaching all the way in here.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I remember the aftermath
of the Ibis Summer Dash..."
choice_data_list: Everyone has high hopes for your running.
Everyone is counting on your running.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
!
Then, I can run amidst that fervor once more.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The excitement from two months ago is rushing back to me!
I feel like I can run even faster than I did back then!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Right O-o-oh!
Show us what top-speed 1200m running looks like!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Believe, the current you can win!
Hold on, hold on, and dig deep to the end!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...The way I am now, I can win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The excitement is truly incredible.
Fufufu, for sprint races to receive this much attention.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Things have changed so much since back then!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Through Calstone-san, I get to be part of all this excitement myself!
Nothing could make me happier!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It is quite a long way away, isn't it...
